description: Answer a QA question. Answer one open QA question. The question moves to `answered` and the answer shows on the item. An answered question cannot be answered again (409); ask a new one to follow up. The answerer is the caller's identity; pass `agent` to record it as answered by that agent type's QA…

agent.description: The agent type answering — pass your own type when you are QA automation. Omitted, the answer is attributed to the caller's identity.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.
